[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] '''Sha'zee Pow''' was a [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who worked as a security [[Officer/Legends|officer]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

{{RPG|''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Dooku's Secret Army]]''}}
In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] sympathizer [[Aviso]] used the [[XNA-580]], an experimental machine that could alter the brainwaves of some [[Species/Legends|species]], to convince the [[Baran Do]] elders that a [[Plo Koon's Padawan|Jedi Padawan]] sought to bring [[Death/Legends|death]] to Dorin. After the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] landed on Dorin with the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Trantos]], Pow and a security detail arrested the pair and led them away, to be placed on trial.
{{Endgame}}
